cards.title: About KMZ Format
cards.body: KMZ is a compressed (zipped) KML file format used by Google Earth for smaller file sizes and faster loading.

cards.title: About GPX Format
cards.body: GPX (GPS Exchange Format) is the standard format for GPS data, compatible with most GPS devices and fitness apps.

cards.title: Why Convert KMZ to GPX?
items: Import Google Earth data into GPS devices
Use with fitness tracking apps (Strava, Garmin Connect)
Compatible with hiking and outdoor navigation apps
Standard format for GPS waypoints and routes
